healthcare.headline: Social-Healthcare Management Software
healthcare.companyDescription: ResiPlus® is the leading management platform for social-healthcare facilities (nursing homes, day centers, and disability care). Its PWA (mobile/tablet) digitizes daily operations and clinical follow-up for care staff in real time.
healthcare.roleDescription: I lead the Mobile & Tablet Front-end area, coordinating a team of three developers and taking part in the analysis, design, and development of new features for a production PWA. My work combines Front-end development, UX/UI, problem-solving, flow and permissions definition, technical coordination, and product evolution.

impact.title: Technical leadership
impact.body: Managing and mentoring the Front-end team through agile task allocation and accurate estimates, removing bottlenecks in the delivery of new features.

modular.headline: modulAR
modular.companyDescription: modulAR is a platform built from scratch so creatives and artists can sell their work through immersive experiences. The project covers everything from the business model and brand identity to the technical architecture, replacing traditional 2D galleries with real-time 3D/AR interaction.
modular.roleDescription: Sole creator and developer of the end-to-end project. I defined the business idea, the full brand identity (Photoshop/Illustrator), the UX/UI design, the database and back-end architecture (ASP.NET Core MVC / EF Core), and the Front-end, integrating the model-viewer API for Augmented Reality without external apps.

sections.title: From idea to product

impact.title: Functional web application
impact.body: End-to-end development of the platform using MVC architecture, database connection, and Azure deployment.

vc.headline: Psychology & Mediation — Corporate Website
vc.companyDescription: A professional website for a practice specialized in clinical psychology and family mediation. Designed to convey warmth, trust, and professional authority, while supporting client acquisition and appointment booking.
vc.roleDescription: I designed and developed the project end to end, defining the visual identity, color palette, logo, and brand direction. I also structured the experience and content architecture, designed the interface, and built the site with React and Vite, ensuring a responsive, consistent experience across devices.

sections.title: Brand identity
sections.body: How do we build a visual identity that conveys professionalism, warmth, and trust?

sections.title: Communication

sections.title: Digital experience

impact.title: Visual identity
impact.body: Created the logo, color palette, and visual language to establish a professional, approachable, and coherent identity.

impact.title: User experience
impact.body: Structured and designed a clear, responsive experience that makes services easy to understand and navigation seamless on any device.

impact.title: Front-end development

menta.headline: Menta — Psychological Tracking Platform
menta.companyDescription: Menta is a psychological tracking platform designed to connect the patient's experience with the psychologist's work. The product brings together three experiences: an emotional journal for daily tracking, standardized psychological tests with automated scoring, and a clinical space to review the patient's progress, record sessions, and manage documentation.
menta.roleDescription: I designed and developed the product's Front-end experience, defining the navigation architecture, the main flows, and the experience for each user type. The project is conceived as a PWA built with React, with an architecture ready to connect later to an API and a relational database.

sections.title: Patient experience
sections.body: How do we turn emotional tracking into a simple, quick habit?

sections.title: Therapeutic continuity
sections.body: How do we connect what happens between sessions with the work of the practice?

sections.title: Multiple users
sections.body: How do we design different experiences without fragmenting the product?

impact.title: Unified hybrid ecosystem
impact.body: Developed a centralized interface that removes the need for multiple platforms, allowing therapists to see notes, documents, self-scored test progress, and mood logs in one place.

impact.title: Optimized patient experience (PWA)
impact.body: Implemented a patient-focused Progressive Web App for mobile devices, enabling daily interaction (emotional journal and 1-to-10 anxiety scales) with a native feel and without the friction of downloading apps from stores.

impact.title: Structured assessment
impact.body: Digitized standardized tests to allow assignment, response, and automatic scoring within the same flow.

movies.headline: Conversational UX powered by AI.
movies.companyDescription: An AI assistant interface that demonstrates practical integration of modern APIs, conversational UX, and cloud-ready front-end development.
movies.roleDescription: I built an AI assistant interface that combines conversational interaction, API integration, and cloud-ready front-end patterns in a polished product shell.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: The project explores how AI can feel useful rather than gimmicky — with clear interaction states, predictable feedback, and a UI that supports real tasks.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I focused on conversation layout, loading and error states, and a component structure that can evolve as models and APIs change.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A demonstrator that shows practical AI integration, strong UX fundamentals, and production-minded front-end development.

impact.title: Useful AI, not a gimmick
impact.body: Conversation serves a real task, with predictable feedback at every step.

impact.title: Clear interaction states
impact.body: Loading, error, and response are obvious; there is no black box.

impact.title: Conversational UX
impact.body: Chat layout and components are built to evolve with the API.

vinos.headline: Warmth and elegance for a wine bar experience.
vinos.companyDescription: A wine bar that needed an elegant digital experience combining branding, usability, and online reservation features.
vinos.roleDescription: I created a digital experience for a wine bar that blends branding, usability, and reservation features into a cohesive, inviting interface.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: The brand needed to feel premium yet approachable online — reflecting the atmosphere of the physical space and making booking easy.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I developed a visual language with rich typography, balanced imagery, and a simple user path from discovery to reservation.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: An elegant web experience that strengthens brand perception and supports key business actions with clarity.

impact.title: Stronger brand feel
impact.body: Typography and imagery convey the wine bar atmosphere from the first scroll.

impact.title: Simpler booking
impact.body: From discovering the menu to reserving a table, the path is short and obvious.

impact.title: Premium atmosphere
impact.body: The interface feels considered and warm, aligned with the physical space.

packaging.headline: Shelf impact through cohesive packaging systems.
packaging.companyDescription: A commercial packaging collection for food products, with cohesive visual identities focused on brand recognition and print-ready production.
packaging.roleDescription: I designed commercial packaging for food products, building cohesive visual identities focused on shelf impact, brand recognition, and print-ready production files.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: Food brands competing on shelf need packaging that communicates quality instantly — balancing regulation, production constraints, and a distinctive visual identity.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I developed modular label systems, typography hierarchies, and color palettes that scale across product lines while keeping each SKU readable at a glance.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A packaging collection that strengthens brand presence in retail environments and demonstrates design thinking beyond digital interfaces.

impact.title: Shelf impact
impact.body: Each SKU is recognizable on the shelf at a glance, even from a distance.

impact.title: Label system
impact.body: A visual language that scales across products without losing family coherence.

impact.title: Recognizable identity
impact.body: Color, type, and composition build the brand beyond a single pack.

catamaran.headline: Biomimicry applied to human-powered water mobility.
catamaran.companyDescription: Industrial design thesis: a pedal-powered catamaran inspired by biomimicry and human-centered design.
catamaran.roleDescription: My industrial design thesis focused on a pedal-powered catamaran inspired by biomimicry principles — from research and 3D modeling to prototyping and user-centered validation.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: The project explored sustainable leisure mobility on water, combining ergonomic pedaling with a stable twin-hull platform inspired by natural forms and efficient movement.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: Research, sketching, and iterative 3D modeling guided decisions around hull geometry, materials, and user posture — always testing against real usability constraints.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A biomimetic product concept that connects my industrial design roots with the user-centered mindset I bring to digital products today.

impact.title: Sustainable mobility
impact.body: A human-powered leisure craft concept, designed for real use on water.

impact.title: Validated ergonomics
impact.body: Posture and pedaling iterated through 3D modeling and human-use criteria.

impact.title: Biomimetic concept
impact.body: Twin-hull geometry draws from natural forms and efficient movement.
